Amendment of section 179, Act IV of 1969

ORDINANCE XI OF 2000
CUSTOMS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XI OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend Customs Act, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th March, 2000]
F.No.2(.1)/2000-Pub., dated
24-3-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:---
3. Addition of section 20, Act
IV of 1969.--In the said Act, after section 19, the following new section
shall be added, namely:--
"20. Board's power to grant
exemption from duty in exceptional circumstances.--Under circumstances of
exceptional nature, the Board may, subject to such conditions, limitations or
restrictions, if any, as it thinks fit to impose, by a special order in each
case recording such circumstances, exempt any goods from payment of the whole
or any part of the customs duties chargeable thereon.".
